description.zh: 是否级联删除。开启后删除服务组会自动删除服务组下的所有服务。默认不开启。
description.en: Specifies whether to perform a cascade delete. If enabled, deleting the service group automatically deletes all services within the service group. This feature is disabled by default.
The ID of the region to which the service group belongs.
The name of the service group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas delete-group --cluster-id cn-shanghai --group-name foo --cascade-delete false --region cn-hangzhou
